verdict.rationale: Increase provides a full Sandbox environment where every API and dashboard feature is available, plus Simulation APIs to trigger events (e.g., receiving a wire or ACH) without needing production/real-world activity, keeping testing entirely separate from live production data (increase-docs-6, increase-docs-25, increase-docs-26). This directly supports an AI-native user safely testing integrations against a non-production environment. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox fidelity or isolation guarantees, and no explicit mention of automatic switching/credentials separation between sandbox and production.
